jobs.title: Polylance Backend Architecture
jobs.description:
PolyLance Backend Architecture

We are building **PolyLance**, a Web3-based freelancing platform focused on secure payments, trusted reputation, and verifiable work. We are looking for an experienced backend developer to build the backend foundation that connects our frontend, database, and blockchain/smart contracts.

What You’ll Work On:

* User registration, login, and profile management
* Freelancer and client profiles
* Job posting, browsing, and management
* Proposal and application system
* Hiring and project management
* Contracts and project milestones
* Escrow and payment-related backend functionality
* Wallet authentication and blockchain integration
* Freelancer ratings and reputation system
* Proof-of-work / completed project verification
* Notifications and activity tracking
* Basic admin functionality

:Blockchain Integration

The backend should communicate with our smart contracts for important activities such as escrow, payments, transactions, and reputation. You should also handle transaction status, confirmations, failures, and synchronization between the blockchain and our database.

:Database & APIs

Design a clean database structure for users, jobs, proposals, projects, contracts, milestones, payments, reviews, reputation, and transactions.

Build secure and well-organized APIs that allow the frontend to communicate with all major platform features.

Requirements:

We want the backend to be:

* Secure and reliable
* Easy to maintain
* Fast and scalable
* Properly documented
* Easy for other developers to continue working on

**Preferred stack:** Node.js/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL, Redis, Docker, and Web3 libraries. We are open to better alternatives if you can explain your approach.

 Deliverables:
Complete backend source code, database structure, APIs, blockchain integration, authentication, core marketplace functionality, escrow/payment integration, reputation system, testing, API documentation, and deployment/setup instructions.
